set.body: Introduce a compact immutable domain reference containing ordered feature_ids, count, coordinate units/geometry signature, and stable domain signature. Store it in relations and frames, validate source column counts during relation construction, require exact ordered identity at compilation, and include it in plan IDs, receipts, and result metadata. Reversed identities or different masks/spacing must fail before source reads; joint feature permutation must remain invariant.
set.title: Carry exact feature-domain identity through relations and frames
